latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor InShot skill.

- Enables mobile-style AI editing of videos in MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM formats up to 500MB.
- Simple onboarding with automatic cloud session and token setup (no install needed).
- Supports editing features such as trimming, adding music, and text overlays; optimized for TikTok, Instagram, and Reels output.
- Exports high quality 1080p MP4 files in 30–60 seconds using remote GPU processing.
- Handles credit checks, error messages, and re-authentication automatically.
- Accepts natural language prompts and common video file uploads for quick editing workflows.
